name: YUKI BHAMBRI
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A versatile doubles specialist with quick movement, solid groundstrokes, and a reliable net game, complemented by a steady serve.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #83 (April 16, 2018), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #39 (March 3, 2025).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Reached the first round of the Australian Open (2015, 2016, 2018). Best Grand Slam Doubles Performance: Reached the third round of the US Open (2024) and Australian Open (2025).
Notable Achievements: ATP Titles: Won 4 ATP doubles titles, including the 2025 Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships (ATP 500) with Alexei Popyrin and the 2023 Mallorca Championships with Lloyd Harris. Junior Success: First Indian to win the Australian Open Junior Championship (2009) and silver medalist at the 2010 Youth Olympics. Challenger Success: Secured 7 Challenger singles titles and 5 doubles titles. Davis Cup & National Representation: Regular member of India’s Davis Cup team since 2012, with a 10-8 singles record.
Other Highlights: Overcame a 2.5-year injury hiatus (2019-2021) due to a right knee issue. Broke into the Top 50 doubles rankings in 2024 and became India’s top-ranked doubles player in March 2025, surpassing Rohan Bopanna.
Yuki continues to elevate Indian tennis, aiming for deeper Grand Slam runs and Masters success. 🎾🇮🇳
